slices.focus: A library makers event introduces Ariana to neighborhood zines as a complement to formal history books
slices.summary: Ariana tags along to a library makers event for Janelle and discovers neighborhood zines and self-published booklets. She buys a zine about vanished beauty shops and a recipe-memory booklet, expanding her reading to include informal, homegrown local materials alongside formal history.
open_loops: Asking Janelle one low-key question about library zine sources without overloading her
Letting a loose pile of zines form before categorizing
Jotting a few private notes on what appeals about each one
decisions: After tagging along to a library makers event because Janelle needed more adult attendees, Ariana got interested in neig
